title: Kitchen sink cleaned
description: Clean a kitchen sink and the area around it: basin spotless, tap polished, counter dry, mirror streak-free.

criteria.label: Sink basin is spotless, no soap scum or residue
Tap and handles are shiny and free of limescale
Counter around the sink is dry and free of clutter
Mirror above the sink is streak-free

notes: Codes visible in the after shot. Keep the same camera height/angle before and after; avoid reflections of faces in the mirror.
